objective: Represent global narrative function and long-range orchestration over canonical narrative-state IDs without imposing a universal plot template or converting structural pattern detection into literary defect claims.
research_basis: LitVISTA 2026: global narrative function+structure and anchor localization remain difficult for frontier models
Novel benchmark 2025: fiction evaluation benefits from macro/meso/micro separation and ending-sensitive evaluation
Narrative surprise 2025: surprise requires both expectation violation and retrospective coherence
Professional structural editing: narrative flow and organization are audience/purpose conditioned
rules: Every orchestration object references canonical narrative-state event/entity IDs and provenance; no manuscript text is copied into orchestration state.
Function labels are descriptive hypotheses with confidence/status, not mandatory plot beats.
No function type or arc role is required to occur in every book.
ALTERNATIVE/UNRESOLVED function assignments may coexist for the same event; the validator must not force a winner.
A setup/payoff link may remain OPEN, PARTIAL or INTENTIONALLY_UNRESOLVED without being labeled defective.
A question may remain INTENTIONALLY_UNRESOLVED; closure percentage is not a universal quality score.
An arc may plateau, reopen, reverse, terminate early or remain intentionally open without automatic defect classification.
PAYOFF/RESOLUTION claims require explicit referenced events; no synthetic payoff is invented to satisfy a template.
Changing an underlying event/entity/claim creates invalidation candidates for dependent orchestration objects.
Orchestration state cannot authorize prose revision; revision still requires calibrated findings, opportunity admission, preservation gates and independent evaluation.
non_goals: three-act or other universal plot enforcement
automatic defect labels for missing beats
forcing every open question to close
